book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: 1 KORIN Pol so mamey peyr-ar ko sios Korin ko se ma mey kow ha hok non

content: Niohney so kyai hom non

Homkwe uron-pi ko-ar ma lwak yor kokwe meyki kwa nuw-nakey kraipakrai popriy. Seyr hmo uron mokwe Niohney so kyai me siowp kwa nuw-okrue. Seyr kyai, profet-ok me ma mesor kokwe peyrmawk-ar kwa nuw-nanpanan.

Unsaney, sane-ok ma lohruw-a hiykwe, uwrsa me nion non-ohruw-a pey, sawk God se nion-aw non-ohruw-a. Payhokuaw, hiykwe niohney so krai non ouon-aw-ok me lohruw-a, sa ok, hiy ma lohruw-a somokwe, unsaney prueyn liy nonkway ley.
Sawk unsaney, profet-ok ma mesor kow somokwe, hmo ok mokwe sios se hiy-meio ie, seyr hiy-mon kraipakrai, seyr hiy-mon woro-woro.
Uwr, sane-ok ma lohruw-a hiykwe hiykiaw-ayay hiy-mon, sawk uwr, profet-ok ma mesor kow sohokwe, sios se hiy-meio ie.

Hakwe hom lowpwarowp, sane-ok lohruw-a e mon. Sawk kyai kamon kyai sohok ko eir mon ma lwak kokwe senkin, hom lowpwarowp profet-ok mesor e. Payhokuaw, unsaney, profet-ok ma mesor hiykwe uwr, sane-ok ma lohruw-a so eir mon lwak. Payhokuaw, sane-ok somokwe, kankoum uwr lopa lwak ankin, sios se liy hiymon popriy ley.

Hano wayh-om, sa pokon hme ha sane-ok le ohruw-a ankin, hai, hano ok somokwe hme penkin yerki non hiy-mon ihey o? Hai, ha le hokwe, sawk ha God so mesair hrahra-ok o, hyo nonkway-ok o, hyo profet-ok o, hyo hiymon sorasor-ok o, seme hiy-me-sorasor kumay kow lopa lwak ankin, hai, ok senkin somokwe hmekwe penkin hiymon ey so?

Omeme, su ma lwayr lopa, yayh nak-okin owk ey seme kwa nanpanan. Seik-saw-ho o, kowkuo o, hoho yowniy-oksa mokwe, kumay-ar ar-woun-sa ha pa lwak hokwe, hai, unsaney homkwe yowniy senkin senkin mokwe penkin lonuayk nonkway o?
Seyr hu se lou uwr hiykwe, hu hokwe yaprue lou-sa ha pa lwak ankin, hai, aw ley ono ey hokwe, posokwaw lonhan onhan koruay ey so?
Suw mo senkin, hai, hno sane-ok somokwe, kumay lwak lopa lwak ankin, unsaney prueyn hiykwe ok sohok ko meykyar mokwe penkin nonkway ey so? Hno sane-ok somokwe howniy ouon mon lohruw-a ha.
Ki ohokwe wouk-ok kraiar senkin lwak, seyr wouk-ok somokwe meyk non.
Sawk hakwe wouk-ok ko meyk-ar ke nonkway lopa lwak ankin, suw uwr, ok sokwe ma lohruw-a sohokwe hane kokwe uwr suwon se hieyn lira. Seyr hakwe hye kokwe uwr suwon se hieyn lira.
Hom Niohney so kyai me siowp ma lokrue me hokuaw kokwe, hakwe hme senkin kiy-me, homkwe kyai, sios se meio ie ey me kwa nuw-meio kraipakrai.
Sohiy so hokuaw kokwe, unsaney sane-ok ma lohruw-a hiykwe God se kwa mesopok, sa hyekwe kyai hyo sane-ok sohom mo meyk-ar me hiykiaw mesor kumay ey ke ka kow.
Sa hakwe God se sane-ok non mesopok ankin, suw hano niohney hiykiaw mesopok, sawk hano mawkworom hokwe puraw-aw lwak.
Hakwe penkin lon ey so? Hakwe God se kokwe niohney non mesopok ey, sawk hakwe mawkworom non nak-mesopok ey. Hakwe yayh mokwe niohney non lowk ey, sawk hakwe yayh mokwe mawkworom non nak-owk ey.

Sawk hunkwe God so uru hokwe niohney non lowk nakie ankin, hai, uwr prueyn hme nion ma non-hokruw hiykwe, hno ok mo meyk-ar mokwe nonkway lopa lwak ankin, hai, hwon kar ma nak-me ey sohokwe, hiykwe uron kamon-aw penkin non-wak o?
Mo hwon God se yaprue mesopok me-ihey hi, sa hno ok somokwe uwrsa ma non-hokruw me liy hiy-meio ie popriy ley.
Hakwe God se sehe me-ihey, payhokuaw, hano kyai sane-ok ma lohruw-a hokwe, hmo kyai mo eir mon lwak, hakwe sane-ok mokwe, krai-ar nuw-ohruw-a.

Sawk hrom sios mon ma hokruw hokwe, hakwe sane-ok mokwe 1000 sankaw me ankin, hmekwe liy hiymon o? Korey, payhokuaw, homkwe ok sohom mo meykyar mokwe yerki penkin non nonkway a? Sawk hakwe ok iha-sirom, hom ma nonkway popriy, seme-aw hiy-mon sorasor ankin, sohokwe hme hiymon.

Hano wayh-om, hmo nanpanan yor mokwe ney me hieyn peie lwak o. Hmo lon hohuaw yor mokwe ney me hieyn enekwei haraw-aw lwak ankin, suw yaprue. Sawk hmo nanpanan yor mokwe uwr hakamay me hieyn kwa nanpanan e.
God so mamey porih hokwe senkin me,

content.text: “Hakamay hiykwe senkin me, hano uwrsa me kokwe, hakwe uwr sane-ok irweyk non mo kueir nonaw lohruw-a ha ey, seyr uwr meiaw ko mo woki mo kueir nonaw lohruw-a ha ey. Sawk mo senkin lwak hi, hano uwrsa homkwe hane liy lonuayk ley.” Ais 28:11-12

content: Suw senkin lwak, sane-ok kankoum ohruw-a kyai sokukwe meir kamon, nan kiykiy-ay uwrsa mo korey, sawk uwrsa ma nan kiykiy-ay lopa mo. Sawk profet-ok mokwe meir kamon, nan kiykiy-ay uwrsa mo, sawk uwrsa ma nan kiykiy-ay lopa mo korey.

Sa uwrsa lowpwarowp ma nuw-hokruw somokwe, sane-ok nuw-ohruw-a liyay ankin, seyr uwrsa nan kiykiy-ay lopa, hom lyawriy ankin, hai, uwrsa somokwe hmo yor me yaprue lira nanpanan o? Korey, uwrsa somokwe hme kokwe lawk-lawk uwrsa me hieyn-aw lira.

Sawk nan kiykiy-ay uwrsa lowpwarowp homkwe profet-ok mesor ankin, sa uwr prueyn nan kiykiy-ay lopa, seyr uwr prueyn nonkway lopa hiy lyawriy ankin, profet-ok somokwe hye senkin liy mon nanpanan kworpakwor, hiykwe yor piap-araw non. Sa hyekwe profet-ok lowpwarowp sohom lira mesor anon.
Hyo weynpaweyn ouon-aw ma nak-wak sue somokwe kumay mon liy lousne-sa-ousne. Seyr hiykwe God se senkin liy kampueys me-ihey, “Okar, God hiykwe mo eherey lwak soma!”
Weynpaweyn sios mon ma lousne hom non

Hano wayh-om, ha ma kiy-me ohokwe senkin, enekwei hom suhway-aw hokruw ankin, hmo prueyn hiykwe yayh kamon non, hmo prueyn hiykwe sawk ok kamon hiymon sorasor ey non, hmo prueyn hiykwe sawk God so me-hrorsay ok non, hmo prueyn hiykwe sawk sane-ok kankoum ohruw-a, wo, prueyn hiykwe sawk sane-ok mo meyk-ar me me-kumay kow. Weynpaweyn lowpwarowp somokwe seme lon e, nan kiykiy-ay uwrsa lowpwarowp me ka hiymon ie ihey.

Unsaney sane-ok lohruw-a ankin, prueys lohruw-a ankin, se sehe, pruompri lohruw-a ankin, se sehe. Sawk homkwe prueyn prueyn-aw kwa lohruw-a, seyr uwr prueyn hiykwe sane-ok sohom mo meyk-ar me kwa lohruw-a kumay kow, nan-kiykiy-ay uwrsa me.
Sa unsaney, sane-ok sohom mo meyk-ar me me-hrorsay kow ey lopa lwak ankin, sane-ok lohruw-a uwr hiykwe ok lopa kwa lwak meinkiowp, hiykwe hiykiaw God se nion-aw kwa non-ohruw-a.
Profet-ok prueys-aw mesor ankin, se sehe, pruompri non mesor ankin, se sehe. Har homkwe hmo ok me nwakwon onuayk nok, nanpanan mesor anon-anon.
Sa uwr prueyn serey ma liwak, hiykwe me-hrorsay-ok kamon God so mon lonok ankin, uwr, peyr-mon ma lohruw-a pie hiykwe kwa lohya kow, prueyn se.

Suw, hom lowpwarowp profet-ok liy mesor, sawk enekwei kamon-aw sokwaw liy lohruw-a e ko, sawk prueyn prueyn-aw. Homkwe yerki senkin meio ankin, homkwe nonkway liy lonokyaw, seyr homkwe homkiaw-ayay liy hiymon kraipakrai.
Kyai, profet-ok mesor ey sokukwe, uwr ma mesor sohiykiaw lanok anok ohruw-a.
Payhokuaw, God so yor hokwe uwrsa hom suhway-aw ma lohruw-a sian senkin korey, sawk hiykwe lwak marowhway God. Seyr hyo yor mokwe sios lowpwarowp mon kokwe liyliy-aw lwak.
Hromo sios mon kokwe sa homkwe meinkiowp ney-aw lwak e. Homkwe ok liy lohruw-a ley, Juda mo sow hokwe mo senkin me, sa homkwe uwr mo peyrmawk mon peie ley o.
Sa homkwe mesopok non lwak ankin, hmo uwr arian me kwa mesopok onuayk nonkway, hmo a arian mon. Payhokuaw, hromo sow senkin, hromkwe yor, sa hom sios mon ma liarok ohruw-a somokwe, owh-mar lon.
Korin uwrsa om, homkwe homkiaw-ayay peie nak-me-heyr o. Hmey, God so ok kokwe hmo owh mon lousne pie mo? Hai, God so ok kokwe hmo sios hokwaw lonuayk pie ko?
Sa hmo prueyn hiykwe senkin nan ankin, hiykwe profet, seyr Niohney so kyai non, hiykwe senkin kwa nonkway, ok, hme ha ma mey kow somokwe, God so me-kupaku-ok arian.
Hiykwe ok seme nanpanan wayr lopa lwak ankin, hyekwe seyr nanpanan wayr lopa lwak ey.
Hano wayh-om ama, mo sehe, homkwe profet-ok mesor kyai kokwe siowp kwa lokrue. Seyr sane-ok lohruw-a kyai kokwe peie me-sous o.
Sios mo mey lowpwarowp mokwe yaprue nonaw kwa nuw-meio anok anok popriy.
